messages:
maria (AE): OrchidHealth POC — demo tomorrow morning, TTFT looks fine on single calls (~1.2s) but under concurrency it spikes to 6-8s. Customer hit timeouts during walkthrough, they're blocked. Can we triage urgently?

sophie (Sales SE): Which model/variant and region? Any special batching config from their side?

maria (AE): model=redwood/rw-instruct-large-v1, quantization=none, region=us-west-2. Client runs ~12 concurrent requests from our demo harness. batch_size=auto (client SDK).

vivek (ML Eng): Do we have request_id for failing calls? Any 429/503 codes? Cold KV cache can cause big first-token spikes if prefix is long.

nina (OrchidHealth): We saw a bunch of 503s around 14:02 UTC. Request id xq3-21 is one of them. Some responses were truncated.

tim (SRE): Looking at logs for xq3-21 — there's queuing on the frontend, then an OOM retry on a worker, which triggered a fallback host. Snippet: 
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] request=xq3-21 start handler
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] enqueue -> worker 7 (queue_len=18)
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] worker7 start_infer seq_len=1024 batch=4
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] worker7 OOM_retry -> fallback_queue
[2026-03-19T14:02:13Z] fallback-> rw-instruct-large-v1-quant8 on gpu3
[2026-03-19T14:02:14Z] success latency=680ms
```
The initial queueing and OOM/retry explain the TTFT spike. Autoscaler also lagged spinning up new hosts.

sophie (Sales SE): Sounds like concurrency + long sequences + autoscale lag. For demo we should lower max_batch_size or reduce max_batch_latency so we don't wait to accumulate large batches. Also send shorter sequences if possible.

vivek (ML Eng): Also recommend enabling prefix_kv_cache for repeated system prompts. Customer repeats the same system message in every call. If we set header `x-cache-mode: prefix` it will cut first-token latency for warmed prefixes.

maria (AE): Nina asked about pricing if we switch to a short dedicated pool for the pilot. Also asked if we can get credits for the demo failures.

tim (SRE): Estimate for a 24h dedicated buffer (4 GPU-equivalent warm capacity) is ~7k USD. For a 2-week pilot we'd do a scaled commit — I can get exact numbers from finance. Ops can approve a 24h burst to avoid immediate demo failure.

sophie (Sales SE): I'll draft a one-off credit for the demo outage and propose a 2-week dedicated pilot with a follow-up pricing sheet.

security-bot: Security questionnaire: SAML + data encryption at rest/ingress non-trivial — security answers pending from security team.

maria (AE): Nina — can we postpone the live demo by 2 hours or switch to a recorded flow while we patch?

nina (OrchidHealth): 2 hours works. Please confirm the dedicated buffer and that truncated responses won't happen in the rescheduled slot.

tim (SRE): Provisioning buffer now. Also marking worker7 as quarantined until we roll the hotfix. Routing change in progress.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy rw-instruct-large-v1 hotfix rolled to 25% at 14:05 UTC :rocket:

sophie (Sales SE): Action items: (1) tim finish dedicated buffer + routing quarantine, (2) vivek share SDK header sample for prefix_kv_cache, (3) maria confirm credit + pilot pricing with finance, (4) security team answer SAML questions.

maria (AE): Thanks all — I'll update Nina in 10m. :thumbsup:
